findings.title: Timestamp quantization active
findings.evidence: gpu-quantized precision should not treat sub-0.2ms deltas as meaningful.
findings.recommendation: Enable developer timing flags when investigating very small shader regressions.
findings.safeClaim: Large pass-level movements can be compared under gpu-quantized precision.
findings.blockedClaim: Sub-0.2ms regression claims remain blocked under gpu-quantized precision.
findings.nextExperiment: Recapture with gpu-exact precision before acting on small deltas.

findings.title: Repeated transient resource rows
findings.evidence: depthBuffer appears 238 time(s) as transient texture API metadata.
findings.recommendation: Pool or reuse the repeated resource for one capture, then compare resource rows and timing.
findings.safeClaim: depthBuffer appears as repeated transient API resource metadata.
findings.blockedClaim: This does not prove VRAM residency, heap pressure, driver allocation cost, or memory bandwidth saturation.
findings.nextExperiment: Reuse or pool depthBuffer for one capture, then compare resource rows and timing.

findings.title: High timing variance
findings.evidence: At least one work item has high stddev relative to p50.
findings.recommendation: Inspect frame slices for alternating heavy/light frames, shader compilation, resource uploads, or readback stalls.
findings.safeClaim: Measured work timing variance is visible in the captured rows.
findings.blockedClaim: The trace does not identify the variance source without frame slices, browser context, or native/vendor evidence.
findings.nextExperiment: Recapture with frame rows/browser context enabled and compare heavy versus light frames.

findings.title: GPU errors captured
findings.evidence: 1 GPU error(s) were captured during the session.
findings.recommendation: Fix validation/shader/device-lost errors before trusting performance numbers; errors can change browser/GPU scheduling.
findings.safeClaim: GPU errors occurred during the measured session.
findings.blockedClaim: Performance conclusions are blocked until validation/device errors are resolved.
findings.nextExperiment: Fix the captured GPU errors, recapture, then compare the clean trace.
